label: LPS28DFW weather
info: An inject node fires every 5 seconds, triggering the periph-lps28dfw node which reads pressure and temperature from the LPS28DFW dual full-scale digital barometer. The node also computes an estimated altitude from the barometric formula using a configurable sea-level reference (default 1013.25 hPa). The debug tab displays pressure (hPa), temperature (°C), and altitude (m). Adjust the lps28dfw-device config node to switch between Mode 1 (0–1260 hPa) and Mode 2 (0–4060 hPa) full-scale, change the averaging depth (4 to 512 samples), set the output data rate, and enable/disable the IIR low-pass filter.
